questions.prompt: The greedy king destroyed the enemy city through many years of war.
questions.answer: Rēx avārus urbem hostium per multōs annōs bellī dēlēvit.

questions.prompt: We saw the poison hidden in the golden cup.
questions.answer: Venēnum in pōculō aureō occultum vīdimus.

questions.answer: Decem annōs mīlitēs mūrōs oppidī custōdiēbant.

questions.answer: Exsul per ignōtās terrās multōs mēnsēs errābat.

questions.answer: Senex magnum dolōrem trēs tōtōs annōs tulit.

questions.answer: Mercātor avārus trāns mare nāvigāvit ut dīvitiās colligeret.

questions.prompt: After the war the weary general returned to Athens.
questions.answer: Post bellum dux fessus Athēnās rediit.

questions.answer: Nūntiī Carthāginem contendērunt ut victōriam nūntiārent.

questions.prompt: My brother set out for the countryside at dawn.
questions.answer: Frāter meus prīmā lūce rūs profectus est.

questions.answer: Servī fugitīvī per silvās obscūrās domum fūgērunt.

questions.answer: Poēta rēgīnam generōsum amātōrem amāre dīcit.

questions.answer: Hostēs avārōs agrōs nostrōs cupere crēdimus.

questions.answer: Testis reum Rōmam fūgisse iūrāvit.

questions.answer: Explōrātor agmina castra petere nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: The brave youth threw himself into the raging flames.
questions.answer: Iuvenis fortis sē in flammās furentēs iēcit.

questions.answer: Ante lūcem exercitus per agrōs hostium iter fēcit.

questions.prompt: The rumor spread among the crowd against the cruel tyrant.
questions.answer: Fāma per catervam contrā tyrannum crūdēlem mānāvit.

questions.answer: Vulnerātum trāns pontem in urbem portāvērunt.

questions.answer: Virgō flōrēs suāvēs per lītus sinuōsum lēgit.

questions.answer: Victōrēs praedam et reliquiās classis rapuērunt.

questions.answer: Philosophus iuvenēs sapientiam multōs annōs docuit.

questions.answer: Ōrātor impudīcus flāgitium suum ante cīvēs manifēstō cōnfessus est.

questions.answer: Hospes cōmis aureōs calicēs dulcī vīnō complēvit.

questions.prompt: The naked robber feared the harsh punishment decreed by the judge.
questions.answer: Latrō nūdus dūram poenam ā iūdice dēcrētam timēbat.

questions.answer: Mīles pertināx multōs diēs hostibus restitit.

questions.answer: Rēgīna āmēns trēs tōtās noctēs flēvit.

questions.answer: Agricola dēfessus multōs annōs in agrīs labōrāverat.

questions.answer: Bellō confectō legiōnēs fessae Rōmam contendērunt.

questions.answer: Mercātor magnum lucrum spērāns Athēnās nāvigāvit.

questions.prompt: After the storm the sailors returned home safe.
questions.answer: Post tempestātem nautae incolumēs domum revertērunt.

questions.prompt: The messenger, sent by the consul, ran into the countryside.
questions.answer: Nūntius ā cōnsule missus rūs cucurrit.

questions.prompt: The fugitive slaves fled across the wide river at night.
questions.answer: Servī fugitīvī trāns lātum flūmen noctū fūgērunt.

questions.answer: Puer innoxius per silvās obscūrās ad templum ambulāvit.

questions.prompt: Before the battle the leader encouraged his men against the enemy.
questions.answer: Ante proelium dux suōs contrā hostem hortātus est.

questions.answer: Post victōriam turba in forum apertum sē effūdit.

questions.answer: Omnēs putant fortem ducem hostēs superātūrum esse.

questions.answer: Poēta deōs piōs hominēs cūrāre affirmat.

questions.answer: Fūr paenitēns aurum surreptum dominō reddidit.

questions.prompt: For many hours the orator held the attention of the whole crowd.
questions.answer: Multās hōrās ōrātor tōtīus turbae animōs tenuit.

questions.prompt: The conspicuous elm, struck by lightning, fell across the road.
questions.answer: Ulmus conspicua fulmine icta trāns viam cecidit.

questions.prompt: They report that the exile wandered for many years through foreign cities.
questions.answer: Nūntiant exulem multōs annōs per urbēs externās errāvisse.
